::: {.facsimile-meta}
Margin notes tag **wrong at publication**, **outdated** (CJR-X only), **never existed**, or **internal**. Corrected values shown in **red**; computed numbers from data: CA **`r m$n_ca`**, CJR-X **`r m$n_cjrx`**, Track 3 cap **`r m$track3_cap_pct`%**.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

ov <- sprintf(
  '<div class="rl-layer"><div class="rl-bubble" style="top:10%%;right:1%%;"><span class="rl-who">Audit #1 · wrong at pub</span><span class="rl-del">±30%% / 60 pts</span> <span class="rl-ins">±20%% cap every PY (40 pt spread)</span><span class="rl-tag">CMS-1808-F</span></div></div>'
)
html <- sub('id="page-1">', paste0('id="page-1">', ov), html, fixed = TRUE)
ov8 <- sprintf(
  '<div class="rl-layer"><div class="rl-bubble" style="top:15%%;right:1%%;"><span class="rl-who">Audit #6</span><span class="rl-del">110 hospitals / 26 counties</span> <span class="rl-ins">%d hospitals / %d metro areas</span><span class="rl-tag">CMS list</span></div></div>',
  m$n_ca, m$n_ca_cbsa
)
html <- sub('id="page-8">', paste0('id="page-8">', ov8), html, fixed = TRUE)
ov3 <- sprintf(
  '<div class="rl-layer"><div class="rl-bubble" style="top:20%%;right:1%%;"><span class="rl-who">Audit #13 · outdated after Jul 31</span>CJR-X <span class="rl-del">Oct 2027 / 2,500+</span> <span class="rl-ins">Jan 1, 2028 / %s hospitals</span><span class="rl-tag">CMS-1849-F</span></div></div>',
  format(m$n_cjrx, big.mark = ",")
)
html <- sub('id="page-3">', paste0('id="page-3">', ov3), html, fixed = TRUE)
cat(html)
```
